# code2paper

Understand any repository — any language, any size — for every developer. A universal agent skill that reads real code and produces a plain-language guide plus a formal academic paper.

## Key resources

- GitHub repository: https://github.com/AkashPriyadarshii/code2paper
- Live landing page: https://akashpriyadarshii.github.io/code2paper/
- Skill file: https://github.com/AkashPriyadarshii/code2paper/blob/main/skills/code2paper.md
- Related tool (Understand-Anything): https://github.com/Egonex-AI/Understand-Anything
- Packing engine (Repomix): https://github.com/yamadashy/repomix

## Quick start (in any AI agent)

```
/code2paper /path/to/repo
```

## Outputs

- `human-guide.md` — plain-language walkthrough for beginners & vibecoders
- `paper.md` — GitHub-Flavored Markdown academic spec
- `paper.typ` — Typst source (compiles to PDF via Typst CLI)
- `paper.tex` — LaTeX source
- `paper.html` — interactive WebPaper (print to PDF from any browser)

## Feature summary

- Universal agent skill — works in Claude Code, OpenCode, Codex, Gemini CLI, Cursor
- 100+ language support (2026 ecosystem): import syntax, entrypoint conventions
- Real code reading: entrypoints, dependency hubs, top-LOC modules
- Measured metrics: files, LOC, cyclomatic complexity, dependency edges
- Foundation-first reading order from the real dependency graph
- Never guesses — unverified items are labeled "not verified"
